text:
Cheng: FYI I rolled a small change that splits prefill vs decode batches into separate queue cohorts to reduce KV contention. After the change we're seeing ~8% p99 decode latency regression on r5b-gpu-01. Anyone seen similar?

Sam: saw the alert. can you paste the heatmap/profile?

Cheng: gist: prefill cohort now does eager KV warmup but handshake cost between cohorts increased. attaching flame excerpt (text): prefill:kv_warmup -> cohort_handoff -> decode:kernel_switch spikes.

Maria: hmm that handshake is expected but shouldn't add that much. what are our token_budget targets for each cohort?

Cheng: we set prefill_budget=256 and decode_budget=128 for the experiment. goal was to keep prefill groups large to amortize KV.

Julia: 256 prefill seems high for short prompts. if prefill dominates, decode queues get starved and then decode bursts create kernel churn. could explain p99.

Alex: Another angle: kernel selection is oscillating because batch shapes differ between the cohorts. when decode batch arrives it's small and picks a different kernel path, causing cache thrash.

Sam: agree. propose: reduce prefill_budget to 96 for short prompt paths + add soft affinity so flows that share KV stay on same GPU for a short window. also add a tiny overlap window when cohort handoff can happen without a hard handshake.

Cheng: sounds reasonable. any config snippet we can try quickly?

Maria: here's a minimal tweak we ran in staging that looked promising:

```json
{
  "cohorts": [
    {"name": "prefill", "token_budget": 96, "queue_max_ms": 40, "kv_priming": "eager"},
    {"name": "decode",  "token_budget": 128, "queue_max_ms": 12, "kv_priming": "lazy"}
  ],
  "handoff": {"soft_overlap_ms": 10, "affinity_window_ms": 200}
}
```

Julia: soft_overlap_ms=10 reduced the handoff tail in staging. affinity_window keeps kernel selection stable for quick follow-ups.

Alex: also add a lightweight metric tag to batches so kernel-selector can prefer previous kernel when affinity tag is present. avoid full cache invalidation.

Sam: can we gate rollout behind an A/B and track p50/p95/p99 + kernel_switch_count + kv_miss_rate?

Cheng: yes I'll run an A/B on a small fleet (r5b-gpu-{01..04}) with those flags. will log metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy started: cheng/prefill-decode-cohort-tune -> prod-stage (canary: r5b-gpu-01..02) at 2024-05-12T14:12:38Z :rocket:

Maria: if p99 still regresses, one more experiment: keep prefill budget high but enable decode micro-batching (allow decode to form tiny groups up to 4 requests before kernel choice). that reduces oscillation without starving decode.

Cheng: good idea. will try initial config (Maria's) + metric dashboard. will report results in ~30m. thanks all :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks — ping here when you have the first numbers.

Cheng: update 1715502748: canary looks better: p99 decode down 5% vs before-change, kernel_switch_count down 18%, kv_miss_rate stable. rolling to rest of cluster in 10m.

Maria: awesome. leaving follow-ups: add batch tag propagation and a small e2e test for cohort handoff latency.

Julia: i'll open a short RFC to document the 'soft_overlap' semantics and affinity tag.

Alex: noted perf wins but track cost impact (prefill smaller budget may increase token ops).

Cheng: filed follow-ups and RFC links in #eng-runtime. closing thread for now.
